evals.name: exact-output
evals.prompt: Write the acceptance for "refuse a read-only directory".
evals.expected_output: Each item has the command, the starting state, the exact message and the exit code. Does NOT write "shows an error".

evals.name: rewrite-on-decision
evals.prompt: A decision changed the message of item 2.
evals.expected_output: Rewrites item 2 in the same moment. Never leaves the old wording.
